basic_info.description: This beautifully maintained home offers approximately 1,818 square feet of refined living space in one of San Francisco's sunniest neighborhoods-Visitacion Valley. On the market for the first time in 28 years, it sits peacefully on a quiet cul-de-sac, offering both privacy and tranquility.  4 bedrooms, home office, 3 full bathrooms, formal entry, formal living room with woodburning fireplace, formal dining room, updated kitchen, family room, kitchenette, large garage with interior access, wine storage closet, excellent storage, spacious patio, landscaped backyard/garden with new concrete pavers, beautiful gravel, blooming and lush plants and mulch.  2 skylights, Neutra address numbers from Design Within Reach. Inside, you'll find newly refinished white oak hardwood and parquet floors on the main floor, brand-new flooring on the lower floor, and new LED recessed lighting throughout. Period details such as graceful archways, high ceilings, intricate moldings, and beautiful chandeliers blend classic charm with contemporary updates. Close proximity to Grocery Outlet, McLaren Park, Visitacion Valley Greenway, Crosstown Trail to hike or bike, Bayshore Caltrain Station, the T Third Street Line, Muni bus lines, highways 101 and 280, close to shopping village on Leland Avenue & more.
